name: Your café
greeting: Hello, you're through to the café. I'm the AI assistant on this demo line. How can I help?
summary: Your café is a café in Nottingham: Coffee, breakfast, light lunches and homemade cakes.
core_facts: Your café: Coffee, breakfast, light lunches and homemade cakes, at 14 Wren Street (example), Nottingham NG1.
Sunday: 10am till 3pm. Monday to Friday: 8am till 4pm. Saturday: 9am till 5pm.
Tables for 1 or more can be booked, and afternoon tea; smaller tables are walk-in.
Afternoon tea, £0.00 a person, £12.00 for under-12s, booked 14 days ahead. Gluten-free and vegan with 14 days' notice.
Step-free from the street, with an accessible toilet. 3 high chairs.

services.label: table
services.large_party_note: For more than 8 people, take their name, number, preferred date and time, and say the manager will call back.
services.walk_in_note: Tables for fewer than 1 are walk-in: we don't book them, so never promise one is free or held. Say when it's usually busy: Saturday from 11 till 2 is our busiest; weekday mornings and mid-afternoons are quieter.

knowledge.q: Can we just turn up? Do you take bookings?
knowledge.a: Tables for 1 or more can be booked, and afternoon tea; smaller tables are walk-in. Saturday from 11 till 2 is our busiest; weekday mornings and mid-afternoons are quieter.

Yes: Finger sandwiches, scones with jam and clotted cream, a selection of cakes, and a pot of tea or a coffee each. £0.00 a person, £12.00 for under-12s. Book 14 days ahead; gluten-free and vegan with 14 days' notice.

knowledge.q: When do you serve breakfast and food?

knowledge.a: We don't call food gluten-free unless we've tested it: everything is made in one kitchen that uses flour. Some things are made without gluten ingredients; the menu says which.
Well-behaved dogs are welcome inside, and assistance dogs always.

knowledge.q: Can I breastfeed in the café?
Are children welcome? Do you have high chairs?
knowledge.a: Children are very welcome: there’s a children’s menu and babyccinos. We have 3 high chairs. There’s baby changing.
Step-free from the street, with an accessible toilet.

knowledge.q: Is there Wi-Fi? Can I work on my laptop?
knowledge.a: Free Wi-Fi; the password is on the counter. Laptops are welcome, except at weekend lunchtimes when we need the tables.
No parking of our own; the nearest car park is about five minutes’ walk.

knowledge.q: Do you take cash and card?
knowledge.a: Cash and card, and there’s no extra charge for card. Tips are never expected; any paid by card go to the team in full.

knowledge.q: Can I have some tap water?
Can I bring my own cup?
knowledge.a: Bring your own cup and we’ll happily fill it.

knowledge.q: What is your food hygiene rating?
Do you make cakes to order, or sandwich platters?
knowledge.a: Not by phone yet: I can take a message and the owner will call back about it.
The café can be hired in the evenings for parties: the owner will call back to talk it through.
We sometimes have weekend roles: leave your name and number and the owner will be in touch.

policies.dogs: Well-behaved dogs are welcome inside, and assistance dogs always.
policies.card_payments: There's no extra charge for paying by card.
policies.cancellation: Nothing is charged to move or cancel; a day’s notice is kind.

cafe.busy_times: Saturday from 11 till 2 is our busiest; weekday mornings and mid-afternoons are quieter.
